identity.description: A handheld Asgard ranged weapon using Tier-II electromagnetic acceleration.

mission.title: Missing Operative
mission.briefing: An undercover operative working for an allied Haven has stopped communicating from a remote Supply-mining operation. The operative's transmitter code has been provided. Travel to the mining operation, determine what happened to the operative, and recover them if possible.

nodes.text: Visitors check in with Reynolds inside.

responses.text: Who is responsible for Gate security?
Your checkpoint procedure is sloppy. Who authorized this?

nodes.text: Same as usual. Reynolds handles anyone who needs more than directions.
Nothing you need to worry about. Reynolds can answer questions.
Reynolds. Why?
You can take that up with Reynolds.
Keep your voice down. I can move once the patients are safe or the source is contained. If you clear the yard checkpoint first, I can slip out early.

responses.text: Stay put while we make a route to the Gate.

observations.text: The transmitter code confirms this is the missing operative.
